property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and matching v lengths, transfer returns true and either all external calls to caddress succeeded or the whole call reverted; if it returns true then it must have made all external calls (no partial success).
If transfer returns (does not revert) then it returns true.
If transfer does not revert then it returns true and makes no changes observable to this test other than returning true (i.e., assert non-revert implies returned true).
